description: Plan (contract only) a deterministic real provisional TSC calibration batch built on the frozen PRD-04 packet library from the pinned clinvar_2026-07-07 VUS run. Selection/evidence review only; candidate_direction stays null / POLICY_BLOCKED; conservation asserted fail-loud; outputs outside repo.
authorized_implementation_notes: configs/packet/calibration.yaml only if a genuinely separate run-artifact/version pin is required; otherwise reuse existing configs. No src/raptor/packet/** edits unless a demonstrated missing reusable API blocks the script (record as a blocker, do not silently patch).

authorized_data_commit.constraint: exactly one AGGREGATE, NON-IDENTIFYING source-of-record JSON, committed only AFTER the real run + checker; no per-variant SPDI, no patient data

tester.duty: authors CAL-AC1..CAL-AC8 as executable tests (synthetic oracle + optional real integration) BEFORE implementation; portable, no external data by default

doer.duty: implements scripts/build_tsc_calibration_batch.py to pass the tests; may add, never weaken; reuses frozen packet/scorer/eval public APIs

checker.duty: re-verifies conservation, redaction, determinism, boundary, and eval-only reuse; the real run occurs only after this checker passes

public_functions: build_packet_input(identity, bias_row, stratum_entry, packet_config, run_pins) -> PacketInput
build_candidate_universe(strata, bias_rows, manifest, packet_config, run_pins) -> tuple[CandidateEvidencePacket, ...]
write_outputs(output_dir, universe, batch, render_config, manifests) -> None

cli.output_dir_constraint: REQUIRED; must be outside the repository tree; no patient data
cli.exit_contract: ConservationError or coverage/boundary failure -> non-zero exit before/without partial output

hard_boundaries: candidate_direction=null, null_reason=production_policy_unapproved, review_state=POLICY_BLOCKED for every packet
implied_direction reused ONLY outside src/raptor/packet; basis eval_only_census_selection_metadata
fail-loud source-of-record conservation before any output
BIAS BP4/PP3 aggregation defect pinned as a limitation, never silently corrected
every criterion carries exactly one real ScorerProvenance; a BIAS row is never a PrimaryEvidenceRef; primary_grounding=absent
select_calibration_batch over the 1,571 candidate universe; coverage over populated observed atoms only; no Cartesian cells
outputs outside repo under required --output-dir; no patient data
FIRST_PASS + queue carry no direction/stratum/AAVC; operator manifest may carry census_selection_stratum
AAVC omitted unless a pinned input is supplied; no network call
no benchmark labels/knowns read; no submission/public worklist
blockers: STRENGTH-LABELING PIN: the doer must pin the exact (strength_map, tavtigian_points, tavtigian_cutoffs, automatable_criteria) tuple that reproduces the census 238 LP + 1,333 LB counts and the 20 + 10 exact-strength pattern catalog (e.g. BP4 int 3 -> strong yielding {BP4 Strong, PM2 Supporting} = -3). If no pinned config tuple reproduces the census, resolve against the census oracle; do not silently re-label.

EXTERNAL ARTIFACT AVAILABILITY: the real run requires the raptor-data manifest + BIAS TSV + provenance at CLI-supplied paths; the unit test must not depend on them (synthetic oracle + env/path-gated real integration).
MISSING REUSABLE API (conditional): if assembling per-criterion PacketCriterionInput reveals a missing public helper in the frozen packet library, record it here before any src/raptor/packet edit.
